positions.as_written: Take the history of the original injury, the original operation and the re-injury separately, and build a timeline.
Ask whether the current symptom resembles the original one, which separates graft failure from a new problem.
Assess standing alignment, because a varus knee loads a graft abnormally and is a correctable cause of failure.
Assess the menisci and the joint lines, because a deficient meniscus also loads the graft.
A patient in the rehabilitation and confidence group should not be revised, and identifying them is the most valuable thing this assessment does.
- Identifying the group that should not be revised is the most valuable thing this assessment does.
